about: Gorayeb & Associates works from William Street in the financial district, publishes in Spanish first and calls itself los abogados del pueblo. Construction injury work is the practice it leads with, and it names sixteen people, five of them as attorneys.

361 reviews at 4.8, and twenty-seven years by its domain registration, the longest in this ranking. Four bar association memberships published on its own bios, the most of any firm here. Contingency fees, a free consultation, a 24 hour line and hospital visits.
